# Site
> Muhammad Shameel KS — Software Engineer (Agentic Engineering) from Palakkad, Kerala, India. Ships production software at SpeeHive: the PALnxt maritime maintenance platform (Flutter, .NET, React/TypeScript) plus AI agents and automated workflows — from TypeScript to Supabase to deployment.

## What I Do
- AI automation & agentic workflows (OpenAI tool calling, MCP, n8n, Cloudflare Workers)
- Full-stack web development (React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Flutter)
- Backend & API design (Node.js, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MSSQL)
- Infrastructure & self-hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Tailscale, GitHub Actions)

## Projects
- PALnxt (SpeeHive) — Production maritime maintenance platform: Flutter app, .NET services, React/TypeScript web console
- Linear AI Agent — Tool-calling agent inside Linear on Cloudflare Workers
- Asana Coding Agent — AI-powered development automation at SpeeHive
- SpeeHive Social — Agentic AI social media planner (Flutter + Clean Architecture)
- Scentance — Premium fragrance e-commerce, live with real revenue
- Stock Salt — Real-time inventory SaaS for 5 outlets
- Office Pal — College management with anti-cheat exam seating
- Per-Monitor Workspaces — Omarchy/Hyprland plugin, per-monitor workspace pinning
- Hermes Mobile — Expo + React Native client for the Hermes agent
- Shey's STT — Rust speech-to-text for Wayland/Hyprland
